works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 电动单车租赁 App：Trek E-Ride 山地电单车大图占半屏，98% 电量、27 km/h 极速、4.6 分（192 次骑行）三项关键数据一字排开；Available / Good Condition 两枚状态标签加底部黄色 Unlock Bike 滑动按钮，租车前的决策信息一屏给全。
works.comment_en: Electric bike rental app: a full-bleed Trek E-Ride photo with 98% battery, 27 km/h top speed and a 4.6 rating across 192 rides lined up beneath it; Available and Good Condition chips plus a yellow slide-to-unlock button put every pre-rental decision on one screen.
works.title: Electric Bike Rental Mobile App Design

works.author: Phenomenon Labs for Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 导师匹配平台 Mentorly：整屏大红底、白字巨标题“FIND THE RIGHT MENTOR NOT EVERY MENTOR”，底部两张导师真人卡片斜叠错落；用一句反常识口号加真人照片，把“匹配质量而非数量”一次讲透。
works.comment_en: Mentorly mentorship platform: a full-bleed red page with the giant white headline "FIND THE RIGHT MENTOR NOT EVERY MENTOR" and two tilted mentor portrait cards at the bottom — one contrarian slogan plus real faces makes "match quality over quantity" land instantly.
works.title: Mentorship Web App UI – Mentorly

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 远程医疗落地页 Velia：笔记本实拍图里医生视频通话占满首屏，大标题“Quality care from home. Talk to a licensed doctor in minutes, not weeks.”，左上角“DOCTORS ONLINE NOW”绿点与右下“Book a Visit”按钮、平均等待 8 分钟一并收进；医疗落地页用“真人问诊画面 + 等待时间”建立信任，比参数堆砌管用。
works.comment_en: Velia telehealth landing page: a laptop mockup filled with a live doctor video call under the headline "Quality care from home. Talk to a licensed doctor in minutes, not weeks." — a green "doctors online now" dot, a Book a Visit button and an 8-minute average wait build trust with a real consultation scene instead of a spec sheet.
works.title: Velia - Telehealth Landing Page Animation

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 视频生成仪表盘 Lumora Studio：深色底上“What will you create today?”大标题加一句话提示框，右侧渲染队列 Dune Walker 62% 实时进度、月度用量 2,450 / 4,000 credits 柱状图；文生视频、图生视频、AI 数字人、配音四条入口并排，创作工具的“提示词—队列—额度”三角一次收齐。
works.comment_en: Lumora Studio AI video dashboard: a dark layout headlined "What will you create today?" over a one-line prompt box; a live render queue (Dune Walker at 62%), monthly usage of 2,450 of 4,000 credits, and four creation entries — text-to-video, image-to-video, AI avatars and voice dubbing — gather the prompt, queue and quota triangle in one view.
works.title: AI Video Generation Dashboard

works.author: Awe Mobile App for Awe Design Studio
works.comment: 个人理财钱包 App：三屏并列——周交易柱状图、余额 $35,674.00 居中放大、VISA 卡 $21,465.00 叠卡展示；收入 $2,353.50 / 支出 $1,294.00 分列，AI Insights 卡片穿插其中；磨砂玻璃配青灰蓝，金融 App 用“三屏分工 + 大数字”把收支、钱包、储蓄一次讲清。
works.comment_en: Personal finance wallet app: three screens side by side — a weekly transaction bar chart, a $35,674.00 balance front and center, and a VISA card showing $21,465.00; income of $2,353.50 against expenses of $1,294.00, with an AI Insights card woven in — frosted glass on slate blue, and a three-screen split that separates spending, wallet and savings at a glance.
works.title: Personal Finance & Digital Wallet App

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 志愿者管理软件 Turnout：暖棕底上“6 OPEN”“KITCHEN STILL NEEDS 2”大字点明缺口，左侧 Board / Pool / Conflicts 导航、右侧志愿者排队列（技能、时长一目了然），底部“拖气泡进空位”的操作提示；把排班表做成一块可拖放的“缺口看板”，社区运营的协调工作被压缩成一屏。
works.comment_en: Turnout volunteer management: a warm brown board headlined "6 OPEN" and "KITCHEN STILL NEEDS 2", with board, pool and conflicts navigation on the left and a volunteer queue (skills and hours visible) on the right; a "drag a bubble into an open slot" hint turns shift scheduling into a draggable gap board.
works.title: Volunteer Management Software Web App Design

works.author: Halo UI/UX for HALO LAB
works.comment: 阅读平台 Riddes：白底大标题“Good Afternoon, Veronika”，在读《奥德赛》配大幅插画封面、Chapter 12 读到 50%；右侧“Next to Read”书脊横排（《沙丘》《三体》赫然在列），下方 Weekly Reading 柱状图加年度目标 64%；阅读类产品用“问候 + 在读书 + 待读书单”三段式，个人感拉满。
works.comment_en: Riddes reading platform: a white page greeting "Good Afternoon, Veronika", The Odyssey open at Chapter 12 with a big illustrated cover at 50%; a "Next to Read" shelf of book spines (Dune, The Three-Body Problem) and a weekly reading chart tracking 64% of the yearly goal — greeting, current book and up-next list in three calm sections.
works.title: Platform for a Reading App ✦ Riddes

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 移动电商购物车流程：左屏商品详情（Massimo Dutti 复古羊毛大衣 $185、黄色 Add to cart 按钮），右屏深色购物车（三件 T 恤 $120 / $290 / $276、数量加减步进器）；从商品页到购物车同一视觉语言，价格、数量、结算路径一次给全。
works.comment_en: Mobile ecommerce cart flow: a product page (Massimo Dutti vintage wool coat, $185, yellow Add to Cart button) beside a dark cart screen with three tees ($120, $290, $276) and quantity steppers — one visual language from product to cart, price, quantity and checkout path all in view.
works.title: Mobile Ecommerce - Shopping Cart Flow
